'''Verannis''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Crime lord/Legends|underboss]] within the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After a group of [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] operatives stole some encoded data from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] regarding the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], Verannis met with the operatives in the [[Spyder]], a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment. There, the operatives engaged Verannis in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and attempted to convince him that it was in Black Sun's interests the aid the Pyke Syndicate in its attempts to track down Leeachos.<ref name="UABS" />
